author: __Chronus
body:
IGN (In Game Name): Coldballer
Banned By:FrostedCupcakez

 

I Understand that I may not be the nicest person there is on avicus and maybe I do things on the server that are not allowed, But the things i do on the server are very minor like "do not spam /msg" even though someone was not listening to me and I had to get their attention and sometimes I may" grief" even though I'm just placing blocks down on me so I can walk faster. These small things should not be enough to get me banned because I honestly think that I should've just gotten temp-banned for a week and not permanently banned. I understand that I do break rules so honestly I think it is time for me to stop doing things that lead to me getting banned and I think from now on I will be good and hopefully stay on this server as long as I can. I also need to talk to you about an issue with me and frostedcupcakez. This is because for some reason she really hates me and it is very weird even though I know that she thinks I am annoying xD. The reason I want to talk to you about her is because she is very bias and I'll tell you why. when I tell a person they suck in the game she doesn't do much and only warns me but for some reason when I say that to her she temp bans which I find very bias. Therefore I understand what I have done in the past but everyone deserves second chances and I also know people who got banned but then appealed to get un-banned so that is what I am asking for, and I will never do anything else on the avicus network.

title: Please Read I Have Been Banned - Coldballer

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

The infraction that was given to you is in fact valid. Over the course of 8 months, you have received over 20 infractions, which is a permanent ban. With all of those infractions, it shows me that you have not learned your lesson and you must wait out your ban. 

"I understand what I have done in the past but everyone deserves second chances" You've already had multiple chances in the past.

You may create another appeal regarding this issue in 6-8 months as it is currently denied.
